requests.name: old_tree_inspiration
requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: screenshot paintover for 3D environment art direction, concept exploration only.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an actual screenshot of Harumachi, a Japanese small-town slice-of-life game. Beautify this exact screenshot and redesign the central old tree and its existing two benches into a distinctive village landmark. Keep the same 16:9 framing, camera perspective, tree location, scale relative to buildings, white boundary walls, distant Japanese houses, ground layout, right-side empty striped market stall, recycling shelter, and all major object positions. Preserve recognizable continuity with the game screenshot.

Primary redesign: give the tree a beautiful asymmetrical broad umbrella canopy, gracefully arching branching structure rather than evenly radial straight cones, a thick gently twisting ancient trunk with naturally fused buttress roots, one memorable curved horizontal bough, a healed knot and a few slender hanging-root cues at the rear. Remove spear-like exposed branch tips. Make roots flow into one another naturally rather than radiate as equally spaced spokes. The crown should read as one coherent living silhouette, with distinct overlapping foliage masses, delicately drawn individual leaves only at selected edges, intentional sky gaps, and luminous dappled shade. A tiny number of ceramic wind chimes hanging from a low outer bough may suggest the town's summer identity. Keep the existing square stone-paving footprint and two bench positions; refine the benches into hand-built warm cedar seats with distinct boards, clean joints and small repairs. Preserve generous open walking space.

Style/medium: a polished Japanese TV anime key-frame background paintover, clean confident fine linework, clear flat local colours, crisp two-tone cel shadows, restrained hand-drawn material detail. Elegant cinematic summer light: luminous blue sky and big cumulus clouds, warm golden highlights, cool lavender blue shade, gentle rim light through leaves. The tree bark must be stylized grey-brown with larger readable grooves and restrained patches, never photographic bark or dense gritty texture. Warm wood, cool stone, rich natural greens with light yellow-green edges.
Constraints: this is an achievable game-art concept, no fantasy structures. Do not replace the town with a different scene; do not add new buildings, water features, temples, giant arches, crowds or characters. Do not turn the benches into a continuous circular seat. Keep the nearby functional prop locations recognizable. No lettering, captions, UI or watermarks. Not photorealistic, not an oil painting, not thick painterly brushwork, not glossy realistic PBR, not miniature toy plastic. Output a single finished landscape image.

requests.name: plaza_facilities_inspiration
requests.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: screenshot paintover for 3D environment art direction, concept exploration only.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an actual screenshot of Harumachi's village plaza recreation corner. Beautify this exact screenshot into a refined Japanese slice-of-life anime game environment. Keep the same 16:9 framing, elevated oblique camera, white boundary walls, distant existing houses, open sandy walking area in the foreground, green activity patch footprint and placement of all existing equipment. Preserve the existing player character's identity, light-blue shirt, dark trousers, pose, size and position.

Refine the EXISTING models into more precise, charming materials and construction:
Left: a small timber stage with colourful bunting, two speakers and the existing microphone; keep it a modest community stage. Draw clear separate deck planks, discreet frame joints and secure slender supports, softly chamfered edges, small signs of handmade maintenance.
Centre: the existing taiko drum on its timber stand, refined hide rim and tidy studs, two resting drumsticks; the existing shallow goldfish-scooping tray with a solid clean wood rim, readable clear blue water and a few simple red goldfish.
Right: the existing pergola with two wooden benches. Make the pergola an elegant straight cedar structure with visible mortise-and-tenon joints, open slender roof lattice partially shaded by climbing summer greenery, so its construction is legible instead of a flat solid roof. Keep the same footprint and all four supporting posts. The benches have separate straight seat boards, refined backs and frame joints. Keep the existing blue-and-yellow slide at the far right in place, with crisp rails, clearly joined supports and restrained enamel shading.
Refine stone paving into distinct cool grey slabs with quiet edge thickness, clean seams and occasional restrained grass only near boundaries. Make lawn transitions less rectangular in appearance using sparse existing flowers and grass at the edge; do not grow a jungle or fill the walkways.

Style/medium: polished Japanese TV anime key-frame background paintover, clear confident fine outlines, flat local colour and crisp two-tone shading, finely selected detail, not photographic texture. Luminous summer daylight, warm golden highlights, cool lavender shadows, warm cedar wood, soft ivory walls, summer green vegetation and indigo accents. More tactile and carefully designed, while retaining the original game's simple anime character.
Constraints: preserve the current map layout, function and scale. No new buildings, ponds, fountains, cafe furniture, extra stalls or extra people. No lettering, captions, UI or watermarks. No photorealism, no thick oil-paint brushwork, no noisy weathered grain, no shiny realistic PBR, no toy diorama. Output a single finished landscape image.

requests.name: plaza_tree_trunk_reference
requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: isolated 3D-model reference derived from the accepted old-tree concept. The attached image is the design source. Extract and faithfully recreate ONLY the central ancient tree's trunk, fused roots and major branches, WITHOUT any leaves, canopy, wind chimes, moss plants, furniture, ground slab, houses, sky or scenery. Show the entire isolated bare wood structure against a completely plain white background in a three-quarter view, all roots and branch ends fully visible, generous margins. Preserve the expressive asymmetrical silhouette of the attached trunk: very thick twisting central trunk, low sweeping arch to the left, upright central limb, broad rear-right counterbalancing limb, naturally tapering curved tips, distinct healed knot on the front face, irregular fused flowing buttress roots. Three large flowing primary root buttresses, with compact secondary roots; no evenly radial star spokes. Hand-painted Japanese TV anime game asset, clean confident outlines, broad quiet grey-brown bark grooves and simplified cel colour, restrained small texture detail, no baked strong lighting or photographic bark. No dramatic studio shadows, no text, no watermark. This must be a compelling organic tree structure to reconstruct in 3D, not a diagram or flat silhouette.

requests.name: plaza_leaf_sprigs_atlas
requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: foliage alpha atlas for the old tree and grape pergola. Use the attached anime concept for its crisp, richly coloured foliage art direction. Produce a square TWO BY TWO texture atlas with four isolated leaf-sprig clusters, one per equal quadrant. BACKGROUND: fully transparent PNG with native alpha everywhere except leaves and slender twigs. Top-left and top-right: two distinct airy branches with 10 to 18 small oval pointed village shade-tree leaves, clear fine anime contours, overlapping natural varied angles and deliberate gaps. Bottom-left and bottom-right: two distinct grapevine sprigs, each with 5 to 9 broad recognizable lobed grape leaves, thin curling tendrils, irregular silhouette, one sprig with a modest small bunch of green unripe grapes. Fresh green leaves, deeper blue-green undersides, a few yellow-green young leaves. Clean Japanese TV anime style, flat colours and crisp restrained two-tone cel shading, no photographic surfaces or heavy scene shadows. Each quadrant's foliage fits fully inside a 12 percent transparent margin, no cross-cell overlap, no grid lines, no labels, no border, no white squares, no background scenery, no flowers. Never fill a quadrant with a solid green cloud.

requests.name: plaza_cedar_atlas
requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: a technical square hand-painted cedar wood albedo atlas, using the attached accepted plaza paintover ONLY as art direction. Four equal edge-to-edge square quadrants, 2 by 2, no margins, no gutters. No perspective: perfectly flat orthographic surface textures for separate 3D wooden boards. Top-left: clean warm honey cedar, restrained longitudinal grain and a few quiet knots. Top-right: slightly sun-faded pale cedar with sparse grey brown grain and a small healed old knot. Bottom-left: rich warm reddish brown cedar for the taiko shell and old structural timber. Bottom-right: cool brown aged structural cedar with restrained worn edge marks and broad natural grain. Wood grain flows VERTICALLY in all four cells. Japanese TV anime game material: fine clean lines, flat quiet local colour, one restrained shadow tone, NO directional cast shadows or highlights baked into the image, no photographic pores, no noisy scratches, no distressed dirty rot, no glossy PBR, no illustrated planks in perspective, no objects, no signs, no text, no borders. The four cells must provide distinguishable age and material hues that remain coherent together.

requests.name: plaza_full_tree_reference
requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. The attached image is the accepted old-tree design for Harumachi. Produce a faithful clean isolated reference of the ENTIRE same ancient village shade tree, with its full broad asymmetric crown, all roots and every canopy edge visible, on a plain white background, generous margins. This reference will be reconstructed as one tree by a 3D generator. Preserve the memorable low sweeping arching bough on the left, the large healed knot, very thick flowing trunk, irregular fused buttress roots and dense but naturally layered leafy crown with deliberate small sky gaps. Every thick branch must taper and merge naturally into foliage; NO exposed flat cut stumps, NO spear-shaped branches, NO evenly spaced radial roots. Keep the root spread compact relative to the broad crown: trunk about 2m thick, crown about 13m wide and tree about 9m tall, roots about 4.4m across. Remove ALL furniture, paving, wind chimes, lanterns, signs, people, houses, sky and scenery; only one complete rooted leafy tree remains. Three-quarter front view with a readable silhouette and depth. Polished Japanese TV anime game asset reference, clean fine confident outlines, restrained flat local colours, crisp two-tone cel shading. Quiet warm grey-brown flowing bark grooves, rich green leaf clusters and yellow-green young foliage, selected individual leaves at edges, no noisy photographic pores or crocodile-scale bark. Neutral diffuse light with no strong directional highlights baked into surfaces, no ground cast shadow. No text, watermarks, labels or grid.
